tags.name: Status
tags.description: Connection state of GitHub and Hostinger

tags.name: Log
tags.description: Recent warnings and errors reported by the backend

get.summary: Recent warnings and errors, newest first (at most 500)

delete.summary: Clears the list (log files are kept)

ConnectionState.description: CONNECTED: a token is stored and works (green). LIMITED: works, but not fully, e.g. missing permissions or rate-limited (yellow). ERROR: a token is stored but cannot be used, e.g. revoked, or the token store is unavailable (red). NOT_CONNECTED: no token is stored (red).

message.description: Why the state is what it is, for LIMITED and ERROR; never contains a token

LogEntry.description: A warning or error reported by the backend. Tokens are always masked.

id.description: Unique within one backend run; newer entries have higher ids

action.description: What the backend was doing, e.g. "GET /user"

statusCode.description: HTTP status code involved, if any

request.description: The request that failed (method, URL, relevant headers/body)
